name: Wet prairie, mid-July
note: The dry accent is dead thatch at the base of the clumps and must stay a minority: a straw-dominated sward is the October negative control, not July. Greens sampled from the July reference photographs used to judge this scene: James Woodworth Prairie Preserve, Glenview IL, 29 July 2021 (a Chicago-region tallgrass remnant) and a DuPage County tallgrass prairie, 24 July 2018. Those are modern remnants photographed in the right month at the right latitude, not evidence about 1835, which is why this record carries no source_id: colours here are render tuning and the evidence lives in the zone records.
